about: A report source (ADR-0151, ADR-0152, ADR-0153, as ADR-0370 section 4 leaves them): Windows of the report a layout makes over a Pivot Source, under display settings, with the whole report's metadata; the cells a change of the data moved, marked; and the operations a Report Version names: Copy, the Selection Summary, a field's Items and the records behind a cell. Transcribed from ExPivot.Engine.Tests' ReportProtocolTests, DetailsQueryTests, ItemTests, ReportLabelMetricsTests and CancelledComputationTests.
